title: Home fire
tldr: Get out, stay out and call emergency services from outside. Use the nearest safe exit, stay low beneath smoke, and close doors behind you if possible. Do not stop for belongings or go back inside for people or pets; tell firefighters where they may be.
steps: Follow the escape route and use stairs, not elevators. Check doors for heat before opening; use another exit if unsafe.
Close doors between you and fire, call emergency services with your location and signal from a window.
Account for everyone at the meeting point and report missing people to firefighters.
Do not reenter until the fire department permits it.
next: Install and test smoke alarms and practice two ways out with the household. Plan assistance for children and people with mobility needs.
watch: An extinguisher attempt must never delay escape or block your exit.
review_status: source-linked editorial review; not independent expert certification
without_help: Escape immediately, gather outside and keep the exit area clear. If trapped, close the door between you and smoke, signal from a window and send your exact location if possible. Do not reenter because the fire seems quiet or because firefighters have not arrived.
household: Choose an outside meeting place and check that every person can use the escape route. Keep keys, mobility aids and shoes accessible. Tell neighbours about a hazard from a safe location; do not organise an untrained entry or rescue.
pack_now: Keep essential medicines, drinking water, a battery light, shoes, phone power and a written contact card within reach. Adapt the load to the hazard and the people with you; do not delay escape to collect equipment.
